name: Slackdump Research
content:
import os
from pathlib import Path

_data_dir = os.environ.get("DATA_DIR")
if _data_dir:
    _root = Path(_data_dir).resolve().parent
else:
    _root = Path.cwd().resolve()
_impl = _root / "slackdump-research.py"
exec(compile(_impl.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), str(_impl), "exec"), globals())

meta.description: Search and inspect Slack history with the local Slackdump executable. Slack access is read-only; results are stored locally.
